item.title: WATCH: Hardik Pandya hits 5 sixes and a four in single over to reach his maiden List A ton in Baroda vs Vidarbha VHT clash
item.description: India all-rounder Hardik Pandya was at his brutal best on Vijay Hazare Trophy return for Baroda against Vidarbha at Niranjan Shah Stadium in Rajkot on Saturday (January 3).
